image_purpose: Celebrates a successful height match with both game branding and win message.

scene_logic.primary_subject: A long-necked Diplodocus on the left, looking extremely impressed and wearing a big, toothy grin. Its tail is wagging happily in the background, creating a sense of joyous movement.
scene_logic.stack_composition: A new, triumphant tower of 3 distinct dinosaurs, perfectly matched to the Diplodocus's height: A strong, purple Triceratops at the base, a bright yellow Parasaurolophus in the middle (with its crest proudly raised), and a tiny, fluffy blue Archaeopteryx perched perfectly on top, extending a wing in triumph to touch the target height.
scene_logic.character_vibe: Pure, unadulterated celebration and joy. Dinosaurs are expressing delight; confetti-like leaves are gently falling around the stack.

game_title_caption.style: 3D playful, blocky font, slightly smaller scale than the 'Player Wins!' text.
game_title_caption.color: Vibrant fire-engine red with a thin white stroke.
game_title_caption.placement: Top-left corner, integrated into the sky or just above the Diplodocus's head, serving as branding.

win_message_caption.style: Large, bold, 3D bubbly font with a high-gloss, metallic finish.
win_message_caption.color: Brilliant gold, fading slightly to orange at the bottom, with a thick white outline.
win_message_caption.placement: Prominently displayed in the upper-right quadrant, perhaps slightly angled for dynamic effect, with a celebratory 3D drop-shadow.

technical_parameters.lighting: Ultra-bright, 'Victory' lighting with a subtle sunburst flare behind the triumphant stack. Sparkling highlights catch on the dinosaurs' surfaces.
technical_parameters.surface_finish: Clean, satin-matte digital character models. Absolutely no grit, no scales, no realism. Saturated and joyful colors.
technical_parameters.negative_prompt: scary, realistic, grit, scales, dark, muddy, blood, open mouths, angry, fighting, falling over, blurry text, all caps, all lowercase, dull red, brachiosaurus, ankylosaurus, edmontosaurus, allosaurus, compsognathus, velociraptor
